title: Open operation comparisons with fixed tensor models and right square
statement: For either the ordinary pro-etale site or its vertical inverse-system site, let d be a Cartesian open square with arbitrary ring sheaves and arbitrary coefficient map, and let t be its site comparison fixing the first projection [def-sf-open-normalization-data]. Given four TensorModels for the four coefficient sheaves and a direct-image/restriction natural isomorphism whose map on sections is restriction along t inverse, there is an Operations record with exactly those four tensor models and that direct-image square. In particular it contains exact open extensions with the specified invertible section units, total left derived pullbacks, the ordinary comparison as the specified adjunction mate, the normalized derived theta, and the pure-tensor normalized restriction comparison.

source.place: Tags 03DI, 03DJ, 0F6Z, 04J0 and 03EL; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E and 07A4. The simultaneous presentation is an agent-formulated construction from these results.

proof.text: For the ordinary site transport the direct-sum extension followed by module sheafification along the pro-etale slice equivalence. Its exactness and invertible unit give OpenExtension. For the vertical site express an arbitrary ring sheaf as its level rings and semilinear transition maps, apply semilinearDerivedSections.localization, and transport its adjunction along the product slice equivalence. Evaluate its unit at each level and use the ordinary localized unit to prove it invertible. This constructs an exact extension on the actual vertical site, without assuming transition maps invertible.

Construct both ordinary pullbacks from a geometric inverse image and extension of scalars. Reuse the independent-universe coefficient-arrow scalar-extension adjunction, structural-map graph argument, ringed pullback presentation and linear-mate correspondence. For the actual continuous-site direct image, verify addition and scalar action sectionwise using the product comparison projections. Restrict the set adjunction to linear maps and compose with scalar extension; this retains the specified right adjoint with site homs in Type u and coefficients in Type (u+1). Choose the already constructed derived-change-of-rings functor as scalar extension and transport the ordinary adjunction along its presentation isomorphism. Flat-term K-flat resolutions, exact algebraic inverse image and K-flat quasi-isomorphism invariance then construct the total left derived pullbacks and resolving-model comparisons.

Compute the mate of the supplied section-normalized right square using the adjunction between open postcomposition and base change. The first-projection condition on t identifies the site mate with the canonical composite-pullback isomorphism; this holds also in the product index category. Its action on sections proves the horizontal module mate invertible. The iterated-mate/conjugation identity therefore makes the vertical module mate invertible, with precisely the required unit equation. Restriction preserves flat terms and K-flatness. Fully faithful restriction to flat K-flat representatives descends the ordinary comparison to theta and proves its specified model equation.

Present restriction as the explicit algebraic inverse image of the continuous cocontinuous open-site functor. Apply the existing universe-independent inverse-image tensor comparison. Evaluate its generalized-section formula on the cartesian pairing of the two underlying module sheaves to obtain exactly the required pure-section equation; its naturality gives the simultaneous tensor naturality. The signed total pullback comparison is invertible because restriction is a left adjoint. Descend this comparison with tensorComparisonDescent for the supplied tensor models, and cancel the inverse representative maps to obtain the required TensorComparison equation. Assemble Operations with exactly the four supplied tensor models and right square.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03DI, 03DJ, 0F6Z, 04J0 and 03EL; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E and 07A4. F9: complete Lean construction using the ordinary slice and vertical semilinear localization, module adjunction, mate calculus, and fully faithful representative descent. No normalized beta or gamma is assumed; no new sorry is introduced.

lean.statement:
theorem normalizedOperations_exists {m : Mode} (d : Input.{u} m) (t : SiteSquare d)
    (tx : TensorModel d.R) (tu : TensorModel (restrictRing m d.j d.R))
    (tx' : TensorModel d.S) (tu' : TensorModel (restrictRing m d.j' d.S))
    (s : direct m d.g d.R d.S d.coefficient ⋙ restrict m d.j d.R ≅
      restrict m d.j' d.S ⋙ direct m d.gU _ _ (cornerCoefficient t))
    (hs : ∀ (N : Mod d.S) (W : (Site m d.U)ᵒᵖ)
      (x : N.val.obj ((openInclusion m d.j ⋙ baseChange m d.g).op.obj W)),
      (s.hom.app N).val.app W x = N.val.map (t.iso.inv.app W.unop).op x) :
    ∃ o : Operations d t, o.tensorX = tx ∧ o.tensorU = tu ∧
      o.tensorX' = tx' ∧ o.tensorU' = tu' ∧ o.rightSquare = s
